top_signals.title: Jensen Huang defends Nvidia's growing financial support for AI ecosystem, says 'the risk is low'
top_signals.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang defended the chipmaker’s growing role in financing AI companies, calling its investments a “once in a generation” opportunity.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: US Army seeks 8,000 new short-range missiles per year
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Army wants to purchase up to 8,000 new short-range missiles per year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Meta pledges to overhaul kids’ safety protections, pay $17 billion to settle social media case
top_signals.summary: A multibillion-dollar settlement with attorneys general from nearly every U.S. state and territory will mean new privacy and safety protections in Meta products.
